doc.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Frustration, the end of Raeburn, and back to Dorsey
summary: The Raeburn band disbanded in under a year, and he returned to Dorsey for the third time.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Was that frustrating not to be, you know, to not have audiences respond?

Sure, sure. A lot of good players, there again, in that band: Hal Schaffer and Pete Candoli. I’m trying to think of the guys who were in that band at that time who really were good players, that enjoyed playing that music.
So that disbanded less than a year after you joined.
So that’s not such a long experience…
No. Murphy:…but then you said you kind of migrated back towards New York and then did you join Dorsey again after that?
So you just kept kind of coming back?
Yeah, three times I went with Tommy. So that Boyd Raeburn experience probably was from California to New York.
